meta.purpose: Generated-workout QA fixtures for MOOD V3 Strength. Expected outcome classes are binding; the reference composition is the simulation pick at seed 0 and is a plausibility reference, not an oracle (recency rotation and live tie-breaks may differ).

presets.no_barbell_machine_gym: commercial default minus barbell, rack, trap_bar, landmine, ez_bar
presets.free_weight_only_gym: barbell, dumbbells, kettlebell, bench, rack, bodyweight, pullup_bar, ez_bar, trap_bar, bands, landmine, box, dip_station, ab_wheel, plate

meta.pass_rule: A case passes when the generator returns the expected outcome class (thin counts as VALID BUILD), every required slot for the duration is filled, no exercise repeats, swap-family distinctness holds where the constraint requires it, sore primary muscles never appear, and the explanation log records any reroute or upper-class fallback. Working-set fill is checked against the WORKOUT STANDARDS band (or a logged duration_underfill_accepted); exercise count is not a validator. Reference compositions are plausibility references only.
meta.version: fixtures v7 (2026-09-23, Strength FREEZE): WA v16 (FB1 bridge relaxation), Library v11 (Kettlebell Swing complexity 2); three S11 Beginner + State Full Body fixtures added (AS235 to AS237); references regenerated.
meta.structure_note: reference_structure is the deterministic block layout from STRUCTURE SELECTION (ST1-ST4) at the fixture defaults (qa_user, 2026-09-22); a plausibility reference like reference_composition. The binding structure checks are validity, compatibility and State-policy conformance, not the exact block layout.
